defined_in.verbatim_quote: “Threshold” refers to the relevant financial thresholds relating to Goods & Services, Works, Concession contracts and Light Touch contracts as set out in the applicable Procurement Legislation and published on the Procurement Intranet page, as amended from time to time.

There are three different procurement regulation thresholds for: 1. Works and concession contracts; 2. Goods and Services; and 3. Light Touch Contracts. The latest values are published on the Procurement intranet page as updated from time to time.

THRESHOLD.description: The statutory procurement thresholds for goods & services, works, concession and light touch contracts (also printed lower-case as 'the relevant threshold(s)'). Named in the PDF but no values given; 1.4 and Appendix B footnote *** say the values are set by the Procurement Legislation and published on the Procurement intranet page.

rules.condition: Procuring a service contract whose estimated value exceeds the Threshold for Goods & Services
rules.band_printed: exceeds the Threshold for Goods & Services
rules.required_action: Consider how the procurement or contract might improve the economic, social and environmental wellbeing of West Berkshire (Social Value Act 2012 and the Council's Social Value Policy)
rules.verbatim_quote: When proposing to procure or make arrangements for procuring a service contract where the estimated value exceeds the Threshold for Goods & Services, consideration must be given as to how the procurement or contract might improve the economic, social and environmental wellbeing of West Berkshire, as required by the Public Services (Social Value) Act 2012, and the Council’s Social Value Policy.

rules.condition: Any contract
rules.required_action: The contract must rest on a recorded decision of the Council, the Executive, or a decision-maker within the Scheme of Delegation
rules.approver: the Council; the Executive; or within the Scheme of Delegation an Executive Decision Maker, a Council Committee or Sub-Committee, or an officer or their delegate
verbatim_quote: All contracts must be in accordance with a decision:
of the Council; or
of the Executive; or
within the Council’s Scheme of Delegation by:
an Executive Decision Maker;
a Council Committee or Sub-Committee; or

rules.condition: Any contract to be entered into
rules.required_action: An existing budgetary provision within the Council-approved Budget must exist before the contract is entered into
rules.verbatim_quote: No contract shall be entered into unless it is in accordance with an existing budgetary provision within the Budget approved by the Council.

rules.condition: Contract award with a value over £500,000
rules.required_action: Treat the award as a Key Decision of the Council (recorded and published as a Key Decision)
rules.verbatim_quote: Any contract award with a value over £500,000 is a Key Decision of the Council.

rules.condition: Expenditure exceeding £500, including payments to suppliers and contractors
rules.required_action: Publish the expenditure under the Local Government Transparency Code 2015
verbatim_quote: Under the Local Government Transparency Code 2015, councils must publish:
Expenditure exceeding £500, including payments to suppliers and contractors.

rules.condition: Invitation to tender for a goods and/or services contract with a value that exceeds £5,000
rules.required_action: Publish details of the invitation to tender (read as continuing the 5.1 list of what councils must publish)
rules.verbatim_quote: Details of every invitation to tender for contracts to provide goods and/or services with a value that exceeds £5,000.

rules.condition: All contracts in progress and awarded
rules.required_action: Publish a register of contracts with key information such as contract value, duration and supplier
rules.verbatim_quote: A register of contracts, including those in progress and those awarded, with key information such as the contract value, duration and supplier.

rules.condition: Every service area, each month
rules.required_action: Report contract information to the relevant board monthly in the format required by Procurement Legislation
rules.verbatim_quote: Service areas are therefore responsible for reporting contract information to the relevant board on a monthly basis in a format as required by Procurement Legislation.

rules.condition: Any contract opportunity advertised by a Service Director
rules.required_action: Advertise electronically on the Council's Procurement Portal so that the opportunity also appears on the Central Digital Platform (worded 'should')
rules.verbatim_quote: All contract opportunities being advertised by the relevant Service Director should be done so electronically on the Council’s Procurement Portal to ensure that such opportunities also appear on the Central Digital Platform (CDP) database.

rules.condition: Contract opportunity above the relevant Procurement Legislation threshold, other than a Further Competition under a compliant Framework Agreement
rules.band_printed: above the relevant Procurement Legislation thresholds
rules.required_action: Advertise on the CDP database before the advertisement appears in any other medium
rules.verbatim_quote: All contract opportunities which are above the relevant Procurement Legislation thresholds must be advertised on the CDP database (a web-based portal provided by the Cabinet Office) prior to such advertisement appearing on any other advertising medium (such as a trade journal etc). However, where a Further Competition is undertaken via a compliant Framework Agreement, an invitation will be sent to those providers on the Framework only and no further advertisement will be required.

rules.condition: Any CDP notice
rules.required_action: The notice must be approved and issued by the Service Lead for Procurement and Commissioning or their delegate
rules.approver: Service Lead for Procurement and Commissioning or their delegate
rules.verbatim_quote: CDP notices must be approved and issued by the Service Lead for Procurement and Commissioning or their delegate as appropriate, who will also assist in the conduct of the procurement.

rules.condition: Any requirement that could be split or disaggregated into smaller contracts
rules.required_action: Do not artificially split or disaggregate a contract to avoid the Procurement Legislation or these Rules
rules.verbatim_quote: There shall be no artificial splitting or disaggregation of a contract to avoid the application of the provisions of the Procurement Legislation and/or these Rules.

rules.condition: Contract with an estimated value more than the appropriate Threshold
rules.required_action: Issue an electronic Invitation to Tender and receive tenders electronically via the Council's Procurement Portal
rules.verbatim_quote: An electronic Invitation to Tender shall be issued by the Council for all contracts with an estimated value that is more than the appropriate Threshold and tenders shall be submitted electronically by tenderers via the Council’s Procurement Portal.

rules.condition: Any electronic tender exercise
rules.required_action: Portal and ITT specify the tender submission format; tenders are held in a secure portal account locked until the stated opening date and time
rules.verbatim_quote: The Council Procurement Portal and the Invitation to Tender must specify the format in which an electronic tender is to be submitted by tenderers and such tenders shall be stored in a secure portal account which is locked until the date and time specified for its opening.

rules.condition: A tender received after the time and date specified for opening
rules.required_action: Reject the late tender unless the Monitoring Officer is satisfied there are exceptional circumstances and the other tenders have not been opened
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: No tender received after the time and date specified for its opening shall be accepted or considered by the Council unless the Monitoring Officer is satisfied that there are exceptional circumstances and the other tenders have not been opened.

rules.condition: Opening of tenders submitted on the Procurement Portal
rules.required_action: Electronic opening conducted by a Procurement Officer, with an audit record kept on the e-tendering system
rules.verbatim_quote: The electronic opening of tenders submitted on the Procurement Portal shall be conducted by a Procurement Officer with an audit record being maintained on the e-tendering system.

rules.condition: Evaluation of any quote or tender
rules.required_action: Evaluate against criteria notified in advance to those submitting quotes or tenders
rules.verbatim_quote: All quotes and tenders shall be evaluated in accordance with evaluation criteria notified in advance to those submitting quotes/tenders.

rules.condition: Any contract award; departure from the most-advantageous / best-value basis only in exceptional circumstances
rules.required_action: Award on the most advantageous, best-value quote or tender having regard to the Social Value Policy, not lowest price alone; any exception approved in advance
rules.approver: relevant Service Director
rules.verbatim_quote: Save in exceptional circumstances approved in advance by the relevant Service Director all contracts shall be awarded on the basis of the quote or tender which is most advantageous and represents best value for money to the Council having regard to the provisions of the Social Value Policy, and not only on the basis of lowest price.

rules.condition: Waiver or exception from competition for a contract with a value of more than £24,999.99
rules.required_action: The waiver must fall within 7.2.1 (not subject to Procurement Legislation, urgent, delay likely to cause financial loss, injury or damage) or 7.2.2 (Executive Director and/or Chief Executive discretion with reasons recorded in writing)
rules.approver: relevant Executive Director and/or the Chief Executive (7.2.2 route)
verbatim_quote: Subject to 7.4 the requirement for the Council to conduct a competitive purchasing process, contracts with a value of more than £24,999.99, may be excepted or waived in the following circumstance:

for contracts which are not subject to the relevant Procurement Legislation Rules, the work, supply or service is required as a matter of urgency and a delay would be likely to lead to financial loss, personal injury or damage to property; or

at the discretion of the relevant Executive Director and/or the Chief Executive, acting lawfully, who may proceed in a manner most expedient for the efficient management of the Council with reasons recorded in writing.

rules.condition: Any waiver of or exception to these Rules
rules.required_action: Waiver granted only by the Monitoring Officer and/or S.151 Officer, sought in advance and only in exceptional circumstances
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer and/or the S.151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: Only the Monitoring Officer and/or the S.151 Officer may grant a waiver or an exception to these Rules, subject to exception values and delegation thresholds detailed in these Rules and/or elsewhere in the Constitution. An officer who seeks a waiver of these Rules shall do so only in advance and only in exceptional circumstances.

rules.condition: Exception for a contract up to the Threshold
rules.required_action: The exception must be approved by the S.151 Officer
rules.approver: S.151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: for all contracts up to the Threshold, the S.151 Officer must approve the exception;

rules.condition: Exception for a contract above the relevant Threshold and up to £500,000
rules.band_printed: above the relevant Threshold and up to £500,000
rules.required_action: S.151 Officer consults the Monitoring Officer and appropriate Executive Director; an exception report is approved by the relevant board (retrospectively only where urgency prevents prior approval)
rules.approver: S.151 Officer (in consultation with the Monitoring Officer and the appropriate Executive Director); exception report approved by the relevant board
rules.verbatim_quote: for contracts above the relevant Threshold and up to £500,000, the S.151 Officer will consult with the Monitoring Officer and the appropriate Executive Director provided and an exception report has been approved by the relevant board unless 7.3 applies and for reasons of urgency such prior approval is not possible in which case a report will be supplied retrospectively;

rules.condition: Exception for a contract over £500,000
rules.required_action: S.151 Officer and Monitoring Officer recommend to the Executive, with an exception report prepared and approved by the relevant board and Corporate Board
rules.approver: Executive, on recommendation of the S.151 Officer and the Monitoring Officer; exception report approved by the relevant board and Corporate Board
rules.verbatim_quote: for contracts over £500,000 the S.151 Officer and the Monitoring Officer will make a recommendation to the Executive provided an exception report has been prepared and approved by the relevant board and Corporate Board.

rules.condition: Any exception or waiver to these Rules (the exception report applies where competition is not excluded by the Procurement Legislation)
rules.required_action: Fully document the waiver and submit a written exception report, with reasons showing it is genuinely required, to the relevant board in advance
verbatim_quote: All exceptions or waivers to these Rules must:
be fully documented;

for any contract where the requirement to hold a competitive process is not excluded by the Procurement Legislation, be subject to a written exception report to be submitted in advance to the relevant board by the relevant Service Director / Head of Service, Service Director or Executive Director (which shall include reasons for the exception or waiver which demonstrate that the exception or waiver is genuinely required);

rules.condition: Any exception or waiver to these Rules (continuation of 7.5)
rules.required_action: S.151 Officer approves and records that the reasons were considered and the circumstances are genuinely exceptional; relevant approvals under these Rules sought
rules.approver: S.151 Officer
verbatim_quote: be subject to approval by the S.151 Officer who shall record they have considered the reasons for the waiver and that they are satisfied that the circumstances justifying the waiver are genuinely exceptional (applications for waivers which are a result of poor contract planning will rarely be considered genuinely exceptional);
have had relevant approval sought under these Rules.

rules.condition: Use of a Purchasing Scheme (framework, DPS, dynamic market, consortium, etc.)
rules.required_action: Before use, advice sought confirming the Council is entitled to use the scheme, the purchases fall within its coverage, and it complies with Procurement Legislation and Council requirements
verbatim_quote: An officer responsible for a procurement exercise may use a Purchasing Scheme provided that they have sought advice to confirm that:
the Council is legally entitled to use the Purchasing Scheme;
the purchases to be made do properly fall within the coverage of the Purchasing Scheme;
the establishment and operation of the Purchasing Scheme complies with the Procurement Legislation (where such applies) and meets the Council's own requirements.

rules.condition: Contract awarded above the Threshold and subject to the Procurement Legislation
rules.required_action: Relevant Service Director produces a written procurement report documenting key decisions, steps and stages leading to award
rules.verbatim_quote: A written report in accordance with the Procurement Legislation shall be produced by the relevant Service Director for each contract that is awarded which is above the Threshold and subject to the Procurement Legislation (the Procurement Legislation places an obligation on the Council to document, for each procurement, key decisions and steps taken and stages leading to the award of contracts).

rules.condition: Each written procurement report produced under 9.1
rules.required_action: Retain the report for three years
rules.verbatim_quote: This report may be requested by the Cabinet Office and shall be kept for three years.

rules.condition: Every procurement procedure, regardless of value
rules.required_action: Document the progress of the procedure (communications, deliberations, documents, negotiation, selection and award) and keep the documentation for three years from award
rules.verbatim_quote: In addition to the above, the relevant Service Director should document the progress of all procurement procedures (regardless of value) including ensuring sufficient information is kept to justify decisions such as communications with contractors and internal deliberations, preparation of procurement documents, any dialogue and negotiation, selection and award. Such documentation must be kept for three years from the award of the contract.

rules.condition: Every purchase
rules.required_action: Written (including electronic) evidence of the purchase exists (worded 'should')
rules.verbatim_quote: There should be written evidence of all purchases (which shall include electronic evidence).

rules.condition: Contracts entered into by the Council as detailed in Appendix B
rules.required_action: The contract is in writing in a form approved by the Monitoring Officer or delegate
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer (form of contract)
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts entered into by the Council as detailed in Appendix B must be in writing in a form approved by the Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer.

rules.condition: Any contract sealed on behalf of the Council
rules.required_action: Legal Services retains the sealed contract documents
rules.verbatim_quote: Legal Services shall retain all contract documents that are sealed on behalf of the Council.

rules.condition: Award of any contract
rules.required_action: Relevant Service Director formally notifies the Service Lead for Commissioning and Procurement so the award is recorded on the Council Contract Register
rules.verbatim_quote: The relevant Service Director must formally notify the Service Lead for Commissioning and Procurement (or nominated officer) of the award of all contracts for the purpose of it being recorded on the Council Contract Register.

rules.condition: Every contract
rules.required_action: Include the standard clauses from the relevant Standard Form of Agreement
rules.verbatim_quote: Every contract shall include the standard clauses set out in the relevant Standard Form of Agreement issued and updated from time to time by the Monitoring Officer or their nominated officer and available from Legal Services.

rules.condition: A Standard Form of Agreement is amended
rules.required_action: Amended form prepared by the relevant Service Director and approved by the Monitoring Officer or delegate
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer
rules.verbatim_quote: Where a Standard Form of Agreement is to be amended, the form of contract shall be prepared/amended by the relevant Service Director for approval by the Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer.

rules.condition: Every contract, where appropriate
rules.required_action: Contract includes minimum clauses: subject matter, time, quality, insurance, default, legal compliance, personal data, anti-bribery cancellation, 30-day payment and flow-down to subcontracts
verbatim_quote: As a minimum, where appropriate, all contracts shall include clauses setting out:
the works, supplies/goods, services, material, matters or things to be carried out or supplied;
the time within which the contract is to be performed;
the quality requirements and/or standards that must be met;
requirements on the contractor to hold and maintain appropriate insurance;
the consequences of the contractor failing to comply with contractual obligations in whole or in part;
requirements on the contractor to comply with all relevant legislation, including (but not limited to) equalities and health and safety legislation;
clauses regarding personal data and its use by the contractor and/or the Council respectively.

the entitlement of the Council to cancel the contract and recover losses in the event that the contractor acted improperly (e.g. seeking to influence the Council to give the contractor any contract) or committed an offence under the Bribery Act 2010.
payment obligations requiring that:
any payment due from the Council is made no later than 30 days from the date on which the relevant invoice is regarded as valid and undisputed; and
any subcontract imposes the same obligations upon the subcontractor, and requires that the subcontractor imposes such obligations in any further subcontract.

rules.condition: Every contract
rules.required_action: A Data Protection Impact Assessment is completed to inform the personal-data clauses
rules.verbatim_quote: Service Directors must ensure that a Data Protection Impact Assessment is completed for all contracts to inform such clauses.

rules.condition: Every contract
rules.required_action: Contract includes enforceable specifications, briefs or technical requirements
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts shall include relevant specifications and/or briefs/technical requirements which are prepared taking into account the need for effectiveness of delivery, quality, sustainability and efficiency (as appropriate) and the need to be able to enforce the delivery of those requirements.

rules.condition: Any relaxation of full indemnities in a contract
rules.required_action: Written authorisation by both the Monitoring Officer and the S.151 Officer (or nominees)
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer and the S.151 Officer or their nominated officers
rules.verbatim_quote: No relaxation of full indemnities releasing the Council from all liability whether provided by public liability insurance or other instrument shall be allowed unless authorised in writing by the Monitoring Officer and the S.151 Officer or their nominated officers.

rules.condition: A performance bond is required
rules.required_action: Bond in a form approved by Legal Services and included in the Invitation to Tender
rules.approver: Legal Services (form of bond)
rules.verbatim_quote: The bond must be in a form approved by Legal Services and must be included in the Invitation to Tender.

rules.condition: A performance bond is not considered necessary (read as: for a contract within 11.2)
rules.required_action: Written risk assessment, approval from the Service Director for Finance and Property, and a copy of the risk assessment on the contract file
rules.approver: Service Director for Finance and Property
verbatim_quote: If a performance bond is not considered to be necessary, the relevant Service Director must:
undertake a risk assessment in writing; and
seek approval from the Service Director for Finance and Property; and
keep a copy of the risk assessment on the contract file for inspection.

rules.condition: Every contract; insurance steps apply where the risk assessment identifies a need for insurance
rules.required_action: Risk-assess the contract; where insurance is needed, set cover levels, confirm the contractor holds current policies, check CIS status (construction) and set professional indemnity levels, in consultation with the Service Director for Finance and Property
verbatim_quote: Every contract should be assessed for risk. If the risk assessment identifies the need for insurance the Service Director must:

in consultation with the Service Director for Finance and Property or nominated officer set adequate levels of insurance cover (including employer’s liability, public liability and any other as determined by the needs of the particular contract);

in consultation with the Service Director for Finance and Property or nominated officer ensure that such insurances are held by the contractor and that the policies concerned are up to date (and/or renewed, as necessary, during the relevant period);

in consultation with the Service Director for Finance and Property or nominated officer who must ensure the contractor’s status under the Inland Revenue Construction Industry Tax Deduction Scheme (for construction contracts);

in consultation with the Service Director for Finance and Property set an appropriate level of professional indemnity insurance for each specific contract that require professional and/or design services (this should not be a standard level but be assessed on a case by case basis).

rules.condition: The Seal is affixed to a document (including a contract sealed under 11.11)
rules.required_action: The sealing is attested and witnessed in writing
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or an officer duly designated by them
rules.verbatim_quote: The affixing of the Seal shall be attested and witnessed in writing by the Monitoring Officer or an officer duly designated by them in accordance with the delegated powers conferred by the Council.

rules.condition: Every sealing of a document (including a contract sealed under 11.11)
rules.required_action: Consecutively numbered entry in the sealing book or electronic record, signed by the person attesting
rules.verbatim_quote: An entry of every sealing of a document shall be made and consecutively numbered in a book or electronic record to be provided for the purpose and shall be signed (including a digital signature) by the person attesting the sealing.

rules.condition: Goods, services, works or concession contract with a value above Threshold
rules.required_action: The contract is sealed
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts whether for goods, services, works or concession contracts the value of which is above Threshold shall be sealed.

rules.condition: A document (such as a contract not required to be sealed) executed on behalf of the Council by signature
rules.required_action: Signed by the Monitoring Officer or a designated officer, and recorded in the register of such documents kept by the Monitoring Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: Where it becomes necessary to execute any document on behalf of the Council not required by law to be under seal, the Monitoring Officer or an officer designated by them in accordance with the delegated powers conferred by the Council shall be deemed to have authority to sign such a document accordingly. A register of such documents shall be kept by the Monitoring Officer or officer duly designated by them.

rules.condition: Contract award with Total Contract Value up to the relevant Threshold
rules.required_action: Award made under the delegated authority of the relevant Service Director (or officers nominated in writing)
rules.approver: Relevant Service Director (or such officers as nominated by the Service Director in writing)
verbatim_quote: up to relevant Threshold
Relevant Service Director (or such officers as nominated by the Service Director in writing) shall have delegated authority to award the contract.

rules.condition: Contract award with Total Contract Value above the relevant threshold and less than £500,000
rules.band_printed: Above the relevant threshold and less than £500,000
rules.required_action: Award by the relevant Service Director on recommendation of the S151 officer and Monitoring Officer, with a written report provided and approved by the relevant board
rules.approver: Relevant Service Director (following recommendation of the S151 officer and Monitoring Officer); written report approved by the relevant board
verbatim_quote: Above the relevant threshold and less than £500,000

Relevant Service Director (following recommendation of the S151 officer and Monitoring Officer) shall have delegated authority to award the contract provided a written report by the relevant Service Director (or such officers as nominated by them in writing) has been provided and approved by the relevant board.

rules.condition: Contract award with Total Contract Value above £500,000 and less than £2.5million
rules.required_action: Key Decision by the relevant Service Director with the Portfolio Holder, on recommendation of the Executive Director, S151 officer and Monitoring Officer; written report approved by the relevant board; Call-In and Forward Plan procedures followed
rules.approver: Relevant Service Director in consultation with the relevant Portfolio Holder (following recommendation by the relevant Executive Director, S151 officer and Monitoring Officer); written report approved by the relevant board
verbatim_quote: Above £500,000 and less than £2.5million

The award of these contracts shall be a Key Decision delegated to the relevant Service Director in consultation with the relevant Portfolio Holder (following recommendation by the relevant Executive Director, S151 officer and Monitoring Officer) to award the contract provided:
a) a written report by the relevant Service Director (or such officers as nominated by them in writing) has been provided and approved by the relevant board; and
b) such decision have been made in accordance with Parts [] (CallIn) and [] (Forward Plan).

rules.condition: Contract with Total Contract Value of £2.5million or more
rules.required_action: Executive approval, given via quarterly reports to the Executive seeking delegated authority for the Service Director to award in consultation with the Portfolio Holder, S.151 Officer and Monitoring Officer
rules.approver: Executive
verbatim_quote: £2.5million or more

Contracts with a value in excess of £2.5million shall require Executive approval, which may be given as below. The Executive shall receive quarterly reports detailing contracts being procured and seeking delegated authority from Executive for the relevant Service Director / to award the contract following the procurement process in consultation with the relevant Portfolio Holder, S.151 Officer and the Monitoring Officer.

rules.condition: Total value (exclusive of VAT) above £1,000 and less than £25,000
rules.required_action: Seek at least one quote from an appropriate source (no advertising mandated)
verbatim_quote: Above £1,000 and less than £25,000
At least one quote must be sought from an appropriate source.

rules.condition: Goods and services, total value (exclusive of VAT) £25,000 or more and less than the Threshold
rules.band_printed: £25,000 or more and less than the Threshold
rules.required_action: Invite quotes via the Procurement Portal from at least three appropriate sources, including at least one SME or VCSE and one local supplier (where appropriate and possible)
verbatim_quote: Goods and Services: £25,000 or more and less than the Threshold

Invitations to quote must be sent via the Procurement Portal to at least three appropriate sources, including at least one SME* or VCSE* organisation and one local supplier ****(where appropriate and possible**).

rules.condition: Goods and services, total value (exclusive of VAT) £25,000 or more and less than the Threshold
rules.band_printed: £25,000 or more and less than the Threshold
rules.required_action: Publish a contract notice on the CDP
verbatim_quote: Goods and Services: £25,000 or more and less than the Threshold
A contract notice must be published on the CDP

rules.condition: Works, concession and light touch contracts, total value (exclusive of VAT) £25,000 or more and less than £500,000
rules.required_action: Invite quotes via the Procurement Portal from at least three appropriate sources, including at least one SME or VCSE and one local supplier (where appropriate and possible)
verbatim_quote: Works, Concession contracts and Light Touch contracts: £25,000 or more and less than £500,000

Invitations to quote must be sent via the Procurement Portal to at least three appropriate sources, including at least one SME* or VCSE* organisation and one local supplier **** (where appropriate and possible**).

rules.condition: Works, concession and light touch contracts, total value (exclusive of VAT) £25,000 or more and less than £500,000
rules.required_action: Publish a contract notice on the CDP
verbatim_quote: Works, Concession contracts and Light Touch contracts: £25,000 or more and less than £500,000
A contract notice must be published on the CDP

rules.condition: Works, concession and light touch contracts, total value (exclusive of VAT) above £500,000 and less than the Threshold
rules.band_printed: Above £500,000 and less than the Threshold
rules.required_action: Full competitive tender process with at least five written tenders sought via the Procurement Portal
verbatim_quote: Works, Concession contracts and Light Touch contracts: Above £500,000 and less than the Threshold
Full competitive tender process applies and at least five written tenders must be sought via the Procurement Portal.

rules.condition: Works, concession and light touch contracts, total value (exclusive of VAT) above £500,000 and less than the Threshold
rules.band_printed: Above £500,000 and less than the Threshold
rules.required_action: Place an advert on the Portal together with information on the CDP (worded 'should')
verbatim_quote: Works, Concession contracts and Light Touch contracts: Above £500,000 and less than the Threshold
An advert should be placed on the Portal together with information on the CDP

rules.condition: Goods and services, works, concession and light touch contracts, total value (exclusive of VAT) above Threshold
rules.required_action: Procurement Legislation procedures: full competitive tender with at least five written tenders sought (where appropriate) via the Procurement Portal
verbatim_quote: Goods and Services Works, Concession contracts and Light Touch contracts: Above Threshold
Procurement Legislation Procedures apply– full competitive tender process with at least five written tenders sought (where appropriate) via the Procurement portal.

rules.condition: Goods and services, works, concession and light touch contracts, total value (exclusive of VAT) above Threshold
rules.required_action: Place an advert on the CDP (worded 'should')
verbatim_quote: Goods and Services Works, Concession contracts and Light Touch contracts: Above Threshold
An advert should be placed on the CDP

rules.condition: Competition not run because the proposed contract is excluded under the Procurement Legislation
rules.required_action: Prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer and, where applicable, prior approval of the relevant board
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer; relevant board where applicable
verbatim_quote: The proposed contract is excluded under the Procurement Legislation.
Prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer is required and where applicable prior approval has been granted by the relevant board.

rules.condition: Contract governed by the Provider Selection Regime (PSR)
rules.required_action: Record key decisions and follow the relevant PSR process
verbatim_quote: Where the contract is governed by the Provider Selection Regime (PSR)
Key decisions must be recorded and the relevant process under PSR followed

rules.condition: Contract awarded under a Purchasing Scheme with no further competition
rules.required_action: Prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer and, where applicable, prior approval of the relevant board
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer; relevant board where applicable
verbatim_quote: The proposed contract is being awarded under a Purchasing Scheme (refer to 8 above) of a type where no further competition is being undertaken a competition has already been undertaken on behalf of the Council or other public sector organisation; or
Prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer is required and where applicable prior approval has been granted by the relevant board.

rules.condition: Contract extension provided for in the existing contract
rules.required_action: Extension approved by the S151 Officer
rules.approver: S151 Officer
verbatim_quote: The proposed contract is an extension to an existing contract where the existing contract provides for such extension.
Approval of the S151 Officer

rules.condition: Variation of scope provided for in the contract or permitted by the Procurement Legislation, contract value below the Threshold
rules.required_action: Prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer
verbatim_quote: The proposed contract is a variation of the scope of an existing contract where the existing contract provides for such a variation or where the variation is a modification permitted under the Procurement Legislation.
For contract value below the Threshold prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer is required.

rules.condition: Variation of scope provided for in the contract or permitted by the Procurement Legislation, contract value greater than the Threshold
rules.required_action: Approval of the relevant board after an (extension) report to the board recommended by the Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer
rules.approver: relevant board, on recommendation of the Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer
verbatim_quote: The proposed contract is a variation of the scope of an existing contract where the existing contract provides for such a variation or where the variation is a modification permitted under the Procurement Legislation.

For contract value greater than the Threshold, approval of the relevant board, following the submission of an extension report to the relevant board with recommendation from Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer

rules.condition: Individual social care services listed in a)–f) (residential, supported living, SEN school placements, personalised packages, sole-provider needs, Shared Lives)
rules.required_action: Record the reasons for the choice of provider on the individual's case notes
verbatim_quote: The contract is for the following social care services:

rules.condition: An exemption is applied to a contract with an annual or total value of more than the Threshold

notes.issue: The document heading is 'Part []': the Part number of the Constitution is a blank placeholder.
The examples under 1.6 are unnumbered bullets, but the last two (page 2) are numbered 1.6.1 and 1.6.2 as if they were sub-clauses.

5.2 (ITT details over £5,000) and 5.2.1 (register of contracts) read as further items of the 5.1 list of what councils must publish, but are numbered as a new clause and its sub-clause. Extracted as printed.

5.2 requires details of every invitation to tender for goods/services over £5,000 to be published, while Appendix B row A says advertising is 'None mandated' for £1,000–£25,000. Publishing ITT details and advertising may be different duties, but the Rules do not reconcile them.

6.2 gives precedence to the Procurement Legislation 'followed by the requirements detailed in 6.1.6' (intranet guidance), apparently ranking guidance above the Constitution and these Rules (6.1.3). Probably unintended.

6.5 says the financial value thresholds at which processes become mandatory are published on the Procurement intranet page; Appendix B introduces itself as the table showing those same thresholds. If the intranet values differ, it is unclear which governs.
Refers to tenderers 'from other member states' (EU-era wording) and leaves 'potential cross border interest' undefined.

6.15 defines Total Contract Value as including Value Added Tax, but the Appendix B value column is headed 'Total Value exclusive of VAT', and Appendix A bands use 'Total Contract Value'. Which basis applies changes which band a purchase falls in. Spend data reports Net amount.
6.23 is a section heading ('Evaluations of Quotes and Tenders') carrying a clause number.

Advertising strength is inconsistent: 6.10 says above-threshold opportunities 'must' be advertised on the CDP and B1/B2 say a notice 'must' be published, but rows C and D (higher values) say an advert 'should' be placed, and 6.8 says Portal advertising 'should' happen.
'more than £24,999.99' recorded as threshold_low 25000 inclusive (whole-pound equivalent); band_printed kept as printed.

7.2.2 allows a waiver 'at the discretion of the relevant Executive Director and/or the Chief Executive', but 7.3 says 'Only the Monitoring Officer and/or the S.151 Officer may grant a waiver or an exception'.

7.2 permits waivers only for contracts of more than £24,999.99, yet 7.4.1 sets S.151 approval for exceptions on 'all contracts up to the Threshold', which includes contracts below £25,000. The Rules don't say whether the Appendix B row A one-quote requirement can be waived.
Garbled wording: 'provided and an exception report'; and 'unless 7.3 applies and for reasons of urgency', although 7.3 contains no urgency provision (urgency is in 7.2.1).

Bands depend on the unknown Threshold: if the relevant Threshold is £500,000 or more, the 7.4.2 band is empty and contracts between £500,000 and the Threshold fall under both 7.4.1 (S.151 approves) and 7.4.3 (Executive).
Submitter listed as 'relevant Service Director / Head of Service, Service Director or Executive Director': Service Director appears twice.

These clauses mix 'should' and 'must' ('should document … must be kept'; 'There should be written evidence'; 'should be assessed for risk … must'). Extracted as rules because they leave records, but the strength of the duty is unclear.
'All contracts … as detailed in Appendix B' does not say which contracts: read as those within the Appendix B bands (above £1,000), but no band is stated, so none is recorded.

10.7.10 is a standalone sentence ('All contracts shall include relevant specifications…') numbered as an item of the 10.7 clause list; 10.7.7 embeds a separate DPIA duty inside the list (extracted as its own rule).

11.4's trigger ('If a performance bond is not considered to be necessary') presumably refers to 11.2 contracts (works or time-bound supplies/services estimated to exceed £500,000), but 11.4 does not say so; 11.2 itself is advisory ('should consider').
Garbled sentence ('in consultation with … nominated officer who must ensure the contractor’s status') and outdated reference to the 'Inland Revenue Construction Industry Tax Deduction Scheme'.

Threshold contract types differ: 1.4 names Goods & Services, Works, Concession and Light Touch; footnote *** says there are three thresholds, with works and concession sharing one; 11.11 (sealing) lists goods, services, works and concession but omits light touch, so above-Threshold light touch contracts have no sealing requirement.
A contract of exactly £500,000 falls in neither row: row 2 is 'less than £500,000', row 3 is 'Above £500,000'.

Bands depend on the unknown Threshold: if the relevant Threshold is £500,000 or more, row 2 is empty and contracts between £500,000 and the Threshold fall in both row 1 (Service Director) and row 3 (Key Decision).

Row 4's label says '£2.5million or more' but its text says 'in excess of £2.5million'. On the text reading, a contract of exactly £2.5m falls in neither row 3 ('less than £2.5million') nor row 4. Row 4 also has a stray '/' ('Service Director / to award').
Placeholders 'Parts [] (Call-In) and [] (Forward Plan)' and grammatical slip 'such decision have been made'.
Row A starts 'Above £1,000'; no procurement requirement is stated for purchases of £1,000 or less.
For works, concession and light touch contracts, exactly £500,000 falls in no band: B2 is 'less than £500,000', C is 'Above £500,000'.
A value exactly equal to the Threshold falls in no band: B1 and C are 'less than the Threshold', D is 'Above Threshold'.

Bands depend on the unknown Threshold: if the Threshold for works, concession or light touch is £500,000 or less, row C is empty and B2 (to £500,000) overlaps D (above Threshold) for values between the Threshold and £500,000.

The SME/VCSE and local-supplier invitation is qualified '(where appropriate and possible)' and footnote ** says no preference may be given; D's five tenders are qualified '(where appropriate)' while C's 'must be sought'. Testing these parts needs auditor judgement.
The VCSE definition opens a parenthesis '(means …' that is never closed.
Key content sits in documents outside the PDF: Threshold values (Procurement intranet page), the local supplier definition (local supplier policy), and the Standard Form of Agreement.
Row C text is garbled ('where no further competition is being undertaken a competition has already been undertaken') and ends with a dangling '; or'.
The variation row requires an 'extension report' for above-Threshold variations: probably meant 'variation report'.
A variation where the contract value exactly equals the Threshold falls in neither 'below the Threshold' nor 'greater than the Threshold'.

The closing paragraph uses 'exemption' (Appendix C says 'exclusion'; section 7 says 'exception or waiver') and 'annual or total value' (6.15 defines Total Contract Value), so it is unclear which cases it covers. Row D (extensions) needs only S151 approval regardless of value, unless the closing paragraph adds board approval above Threshold.
